points.description: States that linked lists can be of variable length, i.e. they can grow or shrink dynamically (size not fixed in advance like an array).
points.partial_credit: Give 2-3 marks for a related but incomplete statement, e.g. easy insertion/deletion or dynamic memory use without saying size can vary.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying in any wording that a linked list's size is variable or dynamic (can grow or shrink, no fixed size). Part marks for related ideas such as flexible memory use or easy insertion/deletion without mentioning variable size. No marks for answers that don't address size or flexibility, or that state a disadvantage or an advantage of arrays.
